# MicCheck

> MicCheck is a free online microphone test for anyone on a phone, tablet, or computer: press one button to see and hear whether your microphone is working.

- Free. No sign-up, no account, no download.
- Works in current Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, and Samsung Internet on Windows, Mac, Linux, ChromeOS, iPhone, iPad, and Android.
- Privacy: all audio is processed in the browser and never leaves the device. Nothing is uploaded or stored on a server.
- What it does: asks for microphone permission, measures the input level (0–100) for five seconds, records a four-second clip for playback, names the active microphone, and gives one plain answer: working, too quiet/muted, access blocked, no microphone found, or microphone busy in another app.

## Pages

- [Microphone test](https://mic-check.web.app/): the tool, how it works, and troubleshooting by device (Windows, Mac, iPhone/iPad, Android, browser permission resets)
- [FAQ](https://mic-check.web.app/#faq): short answers about testing a microphone, permissions, safety, and input level
